name: corpus_bind
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import glob,json,hashlib,os,subprocess,sys
LANE=os.getcwd()
base='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/'
ids=[359433,355862,340527,321035,360013,369268,347656,360343,318758,325013,344493,322706,363099,361779,353552,344764,373534,374065,364399,352130]
sid=set(ids)
files=sorted(glob.glob(base+'mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'))
rows={}
chunkhash={}
for f in files:
    data=open(f,'rb').read()
    chunkhash[f]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    for ln,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
        try:o=json.loads(raw)
        except Exception: continue
        i=o.get('mathdb_id')
        if i is None or int(i) not in sid: continue
        text=raw.decode('utf-8')
        idx=text.index('"statement":')+len('"statement":')
        while text[idx] in ' \t': idx+=1
        dec=json.JSONDecoder()
        val,end=dec.raw_decode(text,idx)
        assert val==o['statement']
        tok=text[idx:end]
        rows[int(i)]=dict(mathdb_id=int(i),chunk_path=f,chunk_sha256=chunkhash[f],one_based_line=ln,
            raw_line_sha256_with_newline=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            raw_line_sha256_without_newline=hashlib.sha256(raw.rstrip(b'\n')).hexdigest(),
            raw_line_bytes=len(raw),newline_present=raw.endswith(b'\n'),
            raw_statement_token=tok,raw_statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(tok.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
            decoded_statement=val,decoded_statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(val.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
            title=o['title'],source_url=o['source_url'],source_name=o['source_name'],references=o['references'],solutions=o['solutions'],status=o['status'],first_stated_year=o['first_stated_year'],raw_line=text)
assert set(rows)==sid and len(rows)==20
out=json.dumps({'ids_order':ids,'rows':[rows[i] for i in ids]},indent=1,ensure_ascii=False)
w=os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'corpus-bindings.json'],input=out,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
for i in ids[:10]:
    x=rows[i]
    print('=====',i,x['title'])
    print('SRC',x['source_url'],'|',x['source_name'])
    print('NEWLINE',x['newline_present'],'SHA(with nl)',x['raw_line_sha256_with_newline'][:16])
    print('ST:',x['decoded_statement'])
    print('REF:',x['references'])
